issues.title: Idempotency: atomic reservation for concurrent same-key requests
issues.recommendation: Keep the sequential v1 contract. Implement pending reservations only before multi-worker or multi-replica deployment.
issues.why: The current single-process use is coherent; solving distributed in-flight coordination before measured value is unnecessary complexity.

issues.title: Accuracy: report hallucination rate over absent-field opportunities
issues.recommendation: Replace the single outcome table with layered request/extraction/semantic accounting. Make expected-null opportunities the hallucination denominator.
issues.why: The current all-fields denominator can hide systematic hallucination and failed extractions currently corrupt null-field semantics.
next: Report document exact match and accepted-extraction rate separately
